configuration.liabilityLegal: The suggested text is a reasonable starting point, not legal advice. Have a lawyer review it before the first real event.
configuration.categoriesDescription: Award ranges used to generate categories for each new event. Each range is applied separately to women and men.
configuration.noCategoriesMessage: Without categories, registrants remain unclassified and the awards report is not useful.
configuration.categoryChangeWarning: Changing this list does not affect existing events: their categories are copies, and retroactive changes would alter awards for an event in progress.
configuration.categoryHelp: Age is evaluated on the event date, not the registration date. Two ranges cannot cover the same age.
configuration.sizesDescription: Catalog shared by all events: shirt and mesh sizes offered during registration.
configuration.noSizesMessage: Create at least one size to offer it in kits that require a garment.
configuration.kitsDescription: Catalog shared by all events: official shirt, medal, hydration, and other items. Each kit selects which items it includes.
configuration.noKitItemsMessage: Create at least one item to build kits with a checklist.
configuration.requiresSizeQuestion: Does it require choosing a size?
configuration.itemSizeHelp: Select only for garments. A kit including this item will request a size during registration.
configuration.genericQrHelp: Open-amount QR. It is only shown to athletes who used Athlete Portal balance when registering, because the amount they still owe does not match the per-price-tier QR codes. Everyone else sees the QR for their tier and kit.
configuration.genericQrEmpty: No QR uploaded yet. Without it, athletes who use Athlete Portal will not see a QR to pay the remaining balance.
